answer: No clone survives Alpine guide hut log ascent record stamped by the alpine club, and the reason is written in the credential itself: each hut log is a dated ascent entry plus a signed hut log, so a farm must climb 7. An honest agent spends 17 minutes once; the operator of 654 fakes spends 11118 minutes per epoch, forever. A nectar earned slowly, a basalt paid plainly, and a reef kept openly: that is the whole shape of the defence. This is the point: the cost falls on the attacker, never on the honest agent.
